story.text: Netherlands and Argentina drew 2-2 in the Quarter-finals of the FIFA World Cup 2022. Argentina won 4-3 on penalties after extra time. Netherlands had more of the ball (51 percent to 49 percent), and Argentina created the better chances by expected goals, or xG, a measure of chance quality (1.73 to 0.84). The goals came from Nahuel Molina at 34:04, Lionel Messi at 72:39 (penalty), Wout Weghorst at 82:17 and Wout Weghorst at 100:32.
